note: Written by measure/holdem-people-run.ts only. A panel score is the level's points against a test player over duplicate deals (each deal twice, seats swapped), strict bust rule. One 30 hand match per seed; the 5, 10 and 15 hand results are read off the same hands.
calibrationNote: no real row reaches the minimum of 40 matches and 10 players, so no calibration is applied: the estimate is the panel alone, labelled so

proxies.beginner: puts chips in before the flop in about 55% of hands (it plays nearly every hand it has to act on), stays in with weak hands against a bet, bets or raises about 15% of the time
proxies.average: puts chips in before the flop in about 50% of hands, calls a little light, bets or raises about 30% of the time when it hits
proxies.strong: puts chips in before the flop in about 45% of hands (a tighter range), calls only at the pot odds, bets or raises about 45% of the time with the strongest hands raising most
